claim: The bundled demo uses valid JPEG, MOV, HEIC, and XMP files and reports three identical, one changed, one missing, and one Live Photo pair.
test: cargo build && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:sample-demo' site/tests/accessibility.test.mjs
sandbox: fresh temporary workspace created by mfa demo; inspect signatures, manifest observations, and demo DOM

claim: The landing page shows a self-hosted recording of mfa demo output from the bundled sample.
test: cargo build && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:cli-demo-recording' site/tests/accessibility.test.mjs
sandbox: fresh browser context; load the visible self-hosted SVG, then compare its command and normalized output line by line with a fresh mfa demo run

claim: mfa demo creates and prints a fresh temporary workspace without reading or writing the caller's media.
sandbox: empty fresh caller directory plus a separate caller-media sentinel; assert the caller stays unchanged, the printed workspace is external and distinct, and file tracing excludes the sentinel

claim: The audit classifies identical, changed, missing, unreadable, and archive-only paths.
sandbox: fresh source and archive trees with independently created files and a non-file archive path

claim: The website opens ?demo=1 and shows a finished sample audit after one click.
sandbox: fresh 390px browser context; activate the first-screen sample link and assert query URL, banner, reset, and counts

claim: The JSON audit report records each file path, byte count, SHA-256, result, and available media details.
sandbox: fresh fixture; independently calculate the SHA-256 and byte size

claim: An audit never writes into or replaces a source or archive file.
sandbox: fresh source and archive trees; attempt new and existing output paths in both trees; snapshot every input file

claim: The CLI reads media content from the source and archive folders chosen for an audit.
sandbox: fresh source/archive plus sibling sentinel; LD_PRELOAD file-access tracing proves both chosen files are opened and the sentinel is not

claim: The report records available JPEG camera details, MOV codec and frame rate, sidecars, and upper-case Live Photo pairs.
sandbox: fresh mfa demo workspace with the shipped valid fixtures

claim: The audit checks byte equality, not picture quality.
sandbox: two visually unchanged JPEG byte streams differing only by appended metadata; assert changed with no quality field

claim: By default the audit matches relative paths; --find-moved reports byte-identical archive files stored elsewhere.
sandbox: same bytes at differently cased nested paths; compare default and --find-moved manifests

claim: The --include-all flag includes files outside the default media and sidecar extensions.
sandbox: fresh .txt-only source/archive pair; compare default and flag results

claim: The CLI emits JSON summaries and returns exit 0 for a clean audit, 1 for differences, and 2 for errors.
sandbox: fresh clean, missing-file, and invalid-input fixtures

claim: The CLI has no account or network dependency.
sandbox: run mfa demo and a normal audit with socket and connect syscalls denied

claim: The static demo sends no third-party requests and stores no browser data.
sandbox: fresh browser context; capture requests and browser storage during the complete demo flow

claim: Install the CLI from the public source checkout with cargo install --path .
sandbox: fresh Cargo install root; install the checkout and run mfa --help

claim: Media Fidelity Audit requires Rust 1.85 or newer.
sandbox: locked check with the exact Rust 1.85.0 toolchain

claim: npm run build writes the complete production static site to dist/site/.
sandbox: fresh checkout production build; assert route shells, 404 and deployment policy, plus hashed JavaScript and CSS assets under dist/site/

claim: Media Fidelity Audit is free under the MIT License.
sandbox: fresh checkout; inspect LICENSE and Cargo metadata
